info.title: Valryde API
info.description: Valryde public jeepney tracking and fleet-management API

get.description: Public readiness check. Returns 503 when the application database cannot be reached.

post.description: Public self-registration for COMMUTER, DRIVER, or OPERATOR. Email verification is required before password login.
Public token exchange that marks a newly registered email address as verified.
Public, enumeration-resistant request. Eligible unverified accounts receive a replacement, time-limited verification link subject to a resend cooldown.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Public login for a verified, active account. Returns JWT access and rotating refresh tokens.
Public Google ID-token sign-in for configured OAuth client IDs and approved self-registration roles.
Public token exchange using an opaque refresh token. The consumed token is rotated and revoked.
Revokes the supplied opaque refresh token. No JWT access token is required.
Public, enumeration-resistant password recovery request for an email address.

post.summary: Reset a password with a recovery token
post.description: Public recovery-token exchange that replaces the account password and invalidates prior credentials.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint for any active VALRYDE role.

patch.description: Authenticated endpoint for any active VALRYDE role to change its display name.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint requiring the current password; prior sessions are invalidated.
Authenticated endpoint that sends verification for a new email address before applying it.
Public verification-token exchange that applies a previously requested email change.

get.description: ADMIN-only account monitoring view. Requires a valid JWT access token.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a user account
patch.description: ADMIN-only status change. Administrators cannot disable their own account.

get.description: Returns an OPERATOR-scoped Driver directory or the global ADMIN directory. OPERATOR callers cannot widen their server-authoritative scope with Admin-only filters.
ADMIN-only paginated directory of Operator profiles with account state and fleet summary counts.

post.summary: Associate a verified Driver with the current Operator
post.description: Looks up a self-registered Driver by verified email. If the account is absent or unverified, returns DRIVER_NOT_READY without creating a placeholder. Existing associations are idempotent for the same Operator and rejected across Operators.

get.description: DRIVER, OPERATOR, or ADMIN view filtered by server-authoritative ownership and group visibility.

post.description: Creates a scoped jeepney record. Client-supplied ownership never overrides the authenticated role.

patch.description: Updates permitted vehicle details; approval-status changes remain ADMIN-only.

get.description: Returns privacy-minimized Driver and jeepney membership details. Operators are limited to owned groups; Drivers must be members of the requested group; Admin has platform scope.

post.summary: Assign a driver to a jeepney
post.description: OPERATOR or ADMIN mutation that enforces same-operator ownership and replaces any active assignment transactionally.

delete.summary: Unassign the current Driver from a jeepney
delete.description: Atomically closes the active Driver assignment within Operator ownership scope. A jeepney without an active assignment returns 409 CONFLICT.

delete.summary: Remove a driver from a fleet group
delete.description: Atomically removes an existing membership within Operator ownership scope.

delete.summary: Remove a jeepney from a fleet group
delete.description: Atomically removes an existing membership. The jeepney effective route is resolved from the remaining direct/group assignments after commit.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated Driver profile active assignment, or null. This is distinct from the broader set of jeepneys visible through ownership or fleet-group membership.
Returns only groups visible to the authenticated DRIVER, OPERATOR, or ADMIN.

post.description: Creates an operator-scoped fleet group. ADMIN callers must identify the target operator.

patch.description: Updates a group only within the authenticated Operator scope, or platform-wide for ADMIN.

post.summary: Add a driver to a fleet group
post.description: Requires the driver and group to belong to the same Operator scope.

post.summary: Add a jeepney to a fleet group
post.description: Requires the jeepney and group to belong to the same Operator scope. Rejects membership that would make the jeepney inherit more than one active fleet-group route.

get.description: Public searchable, paginated endpoint returning only active routes and active directions with canonical Admin-owned GeoJSON geometry.

get.summary: Get active public transit route details
get.description: Returns one active route with its active directions and canonical Admin-owned GeoJSON geometry.
ADMIN-only view including draft, inactive, and archived routes and directions.

post.description: ADMIN-only creation of route identity, public name, description, and display color.

patch.description: ADMIN-only update of canonical route metadata and lifecycle status.

post.description: ADMIN-only creation of a WGS84 GeoJSON LineString direction and corridor tolerance.

patch.description: ADMIN-only update of direction labels, endpoints, geometry, corridor, or lifecycle status.

post.description: OPERATOR-only assignment of one active route direction to an owned jeepney or fleet group.

get.description: ADMIN can read all assignment history. OPERATOR results are restricted to owned jeepneys and fleet groups.

get.summary: Preview active vehicles affected by a route-direction change
get.description: ADMIN-only bounded preview. Effective vehicles use direct-over-group precedence; ambiguous inherited group assignments return ROUTE_ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT.

get.summary: Resolve a jeepney effective route direction
get.description: Returns the single server-authoritative route direction for a permitted jeepney. An active direct jeepney assignment takes precedence; otherwise exactly one active fleet-group assignment is used. Multiple inherited group assignments produce ROUTE_ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT.
DRIVER and OPERATOR results are ownership-scoped; ADMIN can monitor all applications.

post.description: DRIVER or OPERATOR submission for a permitted jeepney; does not activate the vehicle.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a vehicle application
patch.description: ADMIN-only review of a pending application. Repeated or invalid transitions are rejected.

get.description: DRIVER and OPERATOR results are ownership-scoped; ADMIN can monitor all setup requests.

post.description: DRIVER or OPERATOR request for an approved vehicle application.

patch.description: ADMIN-only state transition through approval, scheduling, installation, or rejection.

post.summary: Map a GPS device to a jeepney
post.description: ADMIN-only mapping of unique IMEI, serial, and non-secret Traccar device identity.

get.summary: Get the device mapping for a GPS setup request
get.description: ADMIN-only read of the application-owned mapping identity. A valid request with no mapping returns mapping: null; raw Traccar numeric IDs are never exposed.

post.description: ADMIN-only power, SIM, server, and GPS-fix verification. The jeepney activates only when all checks pass.
